metrics._note: Fallback only. collect-activity.mjs recomputes asOf, commits, commitsByRepo, appsInProduction, trackedFiles, linesOfSource and languages from the checkouts on every refresh and the generator prefers those. These literals are what the page shows when NO checkout is reachable, and they carry their own asOf so an old snapshot can never present itself as today's. Refresh them by copying the computed block, never by estimating.

platform.summary: Shared standards and repository-specific release gates connect each change to tests, review, deployment verification, and documentation updates.

practices: **Typed contracts and boundary validation** are required for new or changed external inputs.
**Test the behavior and the failure path** — a bugfix starts with a failing test that reproduces it.
**Secrets stay out of source control** — builds and deploys receive them through environment configuration or managed secret stores; only public client configuration ships.
**Authorization belongs server-side** — Firestore rules and Supabase RLS protect current privileged paths; known legacy gaps remain explicitly gated.
**Tiered CI** (active / dabble / parked) keeps Actions minutes low; CLI-first deploys through the release gate.
**Conflicts are resolved before merge** — semantic conflicts stop for review and a new validation pass.
**Accessibility & cross-platform** — semantic markup, keyboard paths, and Capacitor guards for native builds.

projects.name: ParentPod
projects.tagline: A shared baby tracker for the whole care team.
projects.blurb: Co-parents, grandparents, and caregivers share one timeline for feeds, sleep, diapers, medicine, growth, and handoffs.
highlights: Live on the App Store and Google Play; offline-first Capacitor build
Firestore rules enforce multi-caregiver access server-side; native IAP via RevenueCat

deepdive.Problem: Caring for a baby is a team sport, but the tools assume one logged-in parent — state fragments across people and devices.
deepdive.Architecture: React + Vite in a Capacitor shell (one codebase → iOS, Android, Web). Firestore provides real-time multi-caregiver sync; security rules enforce role-scoped access server-side; RevenueCat handles cross-platform subscriptions.
deepdive.Engineering: Local-first activity capture reconciles through Firestore, with separate tested release paths for the web and native stores.

projects.name: Longevity
projects.tagline: See what your days are doing to your energy.
projects.blurb: One short daily log — sleep, movement, drinks, water, mood — turns into a plain read on today, the comparisons your own history supports, and the long view. Alcohol is one input among several, not the subject.
highlights: Four-route spine: today's read and check-in, your own comparisons, the long view, and the facts the model consumes
Next.js + Capacitor, fully usable signed out and encrypted on device; signing in adds per-user cloud sync
